Data.UnitTalk_IND: Ini…
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Đây là…

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 메이드장의 상징인 <color=#F7BE45>여명의 빛</color>은... 별의 심장을 <color=#F7BE45>조율</color>하는 능력을 지녔지.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The <color=#F7BE45>Light of Dawn</color>, symbol of the Master Maid, possesses the power to <color=#F7BE45>attune</color> the Heart of the Star.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: メイド長の象徴である<color=#F7BE45>暁の光</color>は…星の心臓を<color=#F7BE45>調律</color>する能力を持っている。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 身为女仆长象征的<color=#F7BE45>黎明之光</color>…拥有能够<color=#F7BE45>调律</color>星之内核的能力。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 身為女僕長象徵的<color=#F7BE45>黎明之光</color>…擁有能夠<color=#F7BE45>調律</color>星之核心的能力。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: La <color=#F7BE45>Lumière de l'Aube</color>, symbole de la Mairesse… possède le pouvoir d'<color=#F7BE45>accorder</color> le cœur des étoiles.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Das <color=#F7BE45>Licht der Morgenröte</color>, das Symbol der Maidenjägerin, besitzt... die Fähigkeit, das <color=#F7BE45>Herz des Sterns abzustimmen</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: La <color=#F7BE45>Luz del Amanecer</color>, símbolo de la Orden de las Doncellas, posee la capacidad de <color=#F7BE45>armonizar</color> el corazón de las estrellas.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A <color=#F7BE45>Luz do Amanhecer</color>, símbolo da Donzela... possui a habilidade de <color=#F7BE45>harmonizar</color> o coração das estrelas.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>แสงแห่งพระอุษา</color>ซึ่งเป็นสัญลักษณ์ของเมเดียจ... มีความสามารถในการ<color=#F7BE45>ประสานสัมพันธ์</color>กับหัวใจของดวงดาว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Simbol dari Master Maid, <color=#F7BE45>Cahaya Fajar</color>... memiliki kemampuan untuk <color=#F7BE45>menyelaraskan</color> jantung bintang.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Biểu tượng của Quản gia trưởng, <color=#F7BE45>Ánh Sáng Bình Minh</color>, sở hữu khả năng <color=#F7BE45>điều chỉnh</color> Trái Tim Tinh Tú.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 안정과 평온을 토대로, <color=#F7BE45>폭주하지 않도록</color> 만드는 아티팩트.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: An artifact that keeps the Heart of the Star <color=#F7BE45>under control</color> through stability and balance.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 安定と平穏をもたらし、<color=#F7BE45>暴走を抑える</color>ためのアーティファクト。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这是一件以稳定与平静为基础，<color=#F7BE45>防止失控</color>的神器。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 這是一件以穩定與平靜為基礎，<color=#F7BE45>防止失控</color>的神器。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Un artefact créé pour <color=#F7BE45>éviter de s'emballer</color>, basé sur la stabilité et la paix.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Ein Artefakt, das auf Stabilität und Frieden ausgerichtet ist und <color=#F7BE45>verhindert, dass man außer Kontrolle gerät</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Artefacto que, basado en estabilidad y serenidad, <color=#F7BE45>evita descontroles</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Um artefato criado para não <color=#F7BE45>explodir</color>, baseado em paz e estabilidade.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: สิ่งประดิษฐ์ที่สร้างขึ้นบนพื้นฐานของความมั่นคงและสันติภาพ <color=#F7BE45>เพื่อไม่ให้พุ่งไปข้างหน้าอย่างไม่ควบคุม</color>
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Artefak yang dibuat untuk tidak <color=#F7BE45>bersalah ria</color> berdasarkan stabilitas dan kedamaian.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Một hiện vật được tạo ra dựa trên sự ổn định và hòa bình để <color=#F7BE45>ngăn chặn sự điên cuồng</color>.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: ...하지만-
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: But...
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: …でも──
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: …不过——
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: …不過——
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: …mais-
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: ...aber-
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: ...pero-
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: ...mas-
Data.UnitTalk_IND: ...tetapi-
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: ...nhưng-

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 그 반대가 된다면 어떨까.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Imagine if it became the exact opposite.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: それが逆になれば、どうだろう。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 如果变成相反的情况，又如何呢。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 如果變成相反的情況，又如何呢。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Que se passerait-il si c'était l'inverse.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Was wäre, wenn das Gegenteil passiert?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: ¿Qué pasaría si fuera lo opuesto?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Se o oposto acontecer, o que faremos?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: จะเป็นอย่างไรถ้าสิ่งตรงข้ามเกิดขึ้น
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Bagaimana jika kebalikannya terjadi?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Nếu điều ngược lại xảy ra thì sao?

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 반대…?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The opposite...?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 相反…？
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 相反…？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: L'inverse…?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Das Gegenteil…?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: ¿Lo opuesto…?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Oposto…?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ตรงข้าม…?
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Kebalikan…?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Ngược lại…?

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>조율</color>이 아니라... <color=#F7BE45>괴리</color>가 된다면 말이야.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: What if it ceased to <color=#F7BE45>attune</color>... and instead brought <color=#F7BE45>Dissonance</color>?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>調律</color>ではなく…<color=#F7BE45>乖離</color>に反転したなら、ということだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 不再是<color=#F7BE45>调律</color>…而是<color=#F7BE45>乖离</color>的话呢。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 不再是<color=#F7BE45>調律</color>…而是<color=#F7BE45>乖離</color>的話呢。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>Ce n'est pas une harmonie</color>… Si c'est <color=#F7BE45>une discordance</color>, alors c'est différent.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>Harmonie</color> ist nicht… <color=#F7BE45>Diskrepanz</color> würde es bedeuten.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>Armonía</color> no... Si se convierte en <color=#F7BE45>discrepancia</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>Harmonia</color> não é... Se <color=#F7BE45>discrepância</color> surgir, é problema.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>การประสานงาน</color>ไม่ใช่... ถ้ากลายเป็น<color=#F7BE45>ความเบี่ยงเบน</color>แล้วนะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Bukan <color=#F7BE45>penyesuaian</color>… Jika itu menjadi <color=#F7BE45>ketidakselarasan</color>, itu berbeda.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>Điều chỉnh</color> không phải… <color=#F7BE45>Sự chênh lệch</color> nếu như vậy thì mới đúng.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 이것이… <color=#F7BE45>괴리</color>의 힘…
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: So this... is the power of <color=#F7BE45>Dissonance</color>...
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: これが…<color=#F7BE45>乖離</color>の力…
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这就是…<color=#F7BE45>乖离</color>的力量…
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 這就是…<color=#F7BE45>乖離</color>的力量…
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: C'est… la force de la <color=#F7BE45>discordance</color>…
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Das ist… die Kraft der <color=#F7BE45>Diskrepanz</color>…
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Esto es… la fuerza de <color=#F7BE45>la discrepancia</color>…
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Isto é… A força da <color=#F7BE45>discrepância</color>…
Data.UnitTalk_THA: นี่คือ… <color=#F7BE45>ความแตกต่าง</color>ของพลัง…
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Ini… kekuatan <color=#F7BE45>Divergensi</color>…
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Cái này… <color=#F7BE45>sức mạnh của sự khác biệt</color>…

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 세상 모든 사람이 너에게 <color=#F7BE45>조율</color>의 책무를 기대하겠지만…
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The entire world expects you to serve as a force of <color=#F7BE45>Attunement</color>...
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 世界中の誰もがお前に<color=#F7BE45>調律</color>の責務を期待するだろうが…
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然世上所有人都期望妳能履行<color=#F7BE45>调律</color>的责任…
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然世上所有人都期望妳能履行<color=#F7BE45>調律</color>的責任…
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Tout le monde dans ce monde attend que tu assumes ta responsabilité d'<color=#F7BE45>harmonie</color>…
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Alle Menschen der Welt werden von dir erwarten, die Pflicht der <color=#F7BE45>Harmonie</color> zu erfüllen…
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Todos en el mundo esperarán que cumplas tu deber de <color=#F7BE45>armonía</color>, pero…
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Todos no mundo esperam que você cumpra o dever de <color=#F7BE45>harmonia</color>, mas…
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ทุกคนในโลกคาดหวังให้คุณรับผิดชอบในการ<color=#F7BE45>ประสานสัมพันธ์</color>แต่…
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Semua orang di dunia akan mengharapkan Anda untuk memikul tanggung jawab <color=#F7BE45>harmoni</color>, tapi…
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Mọi người trên thế giới đều kỳ vọng bạn sẽ đảm nhận <color=#F7BE45>trách nhiệm điều phối</color>…

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 네 본성에 더 어울리는 힘은 그쪽이겠지.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Yes this is the power more fitting for who you truly are.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: お前の本性にこそ、ふさわしい力だろう。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 但更适合妳本性的，应该是这股力量吧。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 但更適合妳本性的，應該是這股力量吧。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Une force qui conviendrait mieux à ta véritable nature, c'est celle-là.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Die Kraft, die deiner wahren Natur besser entspricht, liegt wohl dort drüben.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Una fuerza más acorde con tu verdadera naturaleza sería esa.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Há uma força que se encaixa melhor com sua verdadeira natureza.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: พลังที่เหมาะสมกับธรรมชาติของคุณมากกว่านั้นจะอยู่ที่นั่นแล้ว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Kekuatan yang lebih sesuai dengan sifat sejatimu adalah sisi itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sức mạnh phù hợp hơn với bản chất thực của bạn chính là cái đó.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 이러면 너도 만족할 만한 내용인 것 같은데, 아닌가?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I would think this arrangement suits you perfectly.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: これならお前も満足できると思うが、違うか？
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这样一来，这个条件应该也能让妳满意了吧？不是吗？
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 這樣一來，這個條件應該也能讓妳滿意了吧？不是嗎？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Cela semble être quelque chose qui te satisferait, non?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Das bedeutet, Sie sind zufrieden, aber ich bin es nicht?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Parece ser contenido que te satisfaría, ¿verdad?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Parece ser conteúdo que o satisfaria também, não é?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ดูเหมือนว่าคุณจะพอใจกับสิ่งนี้ใช่ไหม
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Sepertinya itu cukup memuaskan bagimu, bukan?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Nếu như vậy, có vẻ như nội dung này đủ để bạn hài lòng rồi, phải không?

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 공리주의적 사고를 가진 그 여자가 좋아할 만한, <color=#F7BE45>공정</color>한 거래라는 거야.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: A <color=#F7BE45>fair</color> exchange, just the sort that woman with her utilitarian ideals would appreciate.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 功利主義的のあの女が好みそうな、<color=#F7BE45>公正</color>な取引というわけだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这就是那个有着功利主义思想的女人会喜欢的那种，<color=#F7BE45>公平</color>的交易。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 這就是那個有著功利主義思想的女人會喜歡的那種，<color=#F7BE45>公平</color>的交易。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: C'est une <color=#F7BE45>transaction</color> équitable, le genre de chose qu'une femme avec une pensée utilitariste apprécierait.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Es ist ein <color=#F7BE45>fairer</color> Handel, der einer Frau mit utilitaristischem Denken gefallen würde.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Es un trato <color=#F7BE45>justo</color> que le gustaría a esa mujer con pensamiento utilitarista.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Uma transação <color=#F7BE45>justa</color> que agradaria aquela mulher com pensamento utilitarista.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: มันเป็นการค้าขายที่<color=#F7BE45>ยุติธรรม</color>ที่สตรีผู้มีความคิดเชิงประโยชนนิยมจะชอบ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Ini adalah transaksi yang <color=#F7BE45>adil</color> yang akan disukai oleh wanita dengan pemikiran utilitarianisme.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Đó là một giao dịch <color=#F7BE45>công bằng</color> mà cô gái có tư duy công lý sẽ thích.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: ...<color=#F7BE45>공정</color>, 말이군요.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: ...<color=#F7BE45>Fair</color>, you say.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: …<color=#F7BE45>公正</color>、ですか。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: …<color=#F7BE45>公平</color>，是吗？
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: …<color=#F7BE45>公平</color>，是嗎？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: …<color=#F7BE45>Équitable</color>, tu dis.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: ...<color=#F7BE45>Gerechtigkeit</color>, verstehe ich.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: ...<color=#F7BE45>Justicia</color>, eso es.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: …<color=#F7BE45>Justo</color>, entendo.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: …<color=#F7BE45>ความเป็นธรรม</color>นั่นแหละ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>Adil</color>, kata itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: …<color=#F7BE45>công bằng</color>, tôi hiểu rồi.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 그래, 그 빌어먹을 공정함.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Yes. That cursed sense of fairness.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: そうだ、あの忌々しい公正さ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 没错，就是那该死的公平。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 沒錯，就是那該死的公平。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Oui, cette maudite équité.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Ja, diese verdammte Fairness.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Sí, esa maldad justicia.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Sim, essa maldita justiça é uma porcaria.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ใช่ ความยุติธรรมที่น่ารังเกียจของเขานั่น
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Ya, keadilan yang adil itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Vâng, cái công bằng chết tiệt đó.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 모두를 사랑한다는 것은 모두를 미워하는 것이나 마찬가지지.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: To love everyone is no different from hating everyone.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 全てを愛するということは、全てを憎むのと同じだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 所谓的博爱，与憎恨所有人，其实是没有分别的。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 所謂的博愛，與憎恨所有人，其實是沒有分別的。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Aimer tout le monde, c'est détester tout le monde, ou quelque chose comme ça.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Alle zu lieben ist dasselbe wie alle zu hassen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Amar a todos es lo mismo que odiar a todos, supongo.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Amar a todos é o mesmo que odiar a todos, ou algo assim.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: การรักทุกคนเหมือนกับการเกลียดทุกคน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Mencintai semua orang sama dengan membenci semua orang.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Yêu tất cả cũng giống như ghét tất cả.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 절대다수의 행복을 위해서 누군가는 영원히 희생을 감수해야 하는 것.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The happiness of the masses is always built upon someone's endless sacrifice.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 絶対多数の幸福のために、誰かが永遠に犠牲を引き受けなければならないこと。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 为了绝大多数人的幸福，就必须有人永远承受牺牲。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 為了絕大多數人的幸福，就必須有人永遠承受犧牲。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Pour le bonheur de tous, quelqu'un doit sacrifier sa vie.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Um das Glück der absoluten Mehrheit zu sichern, muss jemand für immer Opfer bringen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Alguien debe sacrificarse por la felicidad de muchos.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Para a felicidade de todos, alguém deve fazer um sacrifício.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: เพื่อความสุขของทุกคน ต้องสละสิ่งที่มีค่าบ้าง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Untuk kebahagiaan banyak orang, seseorang harus rela berkorban.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Để hạnh phúc của đa số tuyệt đối, ai đó phải chịu đựng sự hy sinh mãi mãi.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: …그 멍에를 계속 짊어지고 있겠다면…
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: ...Should you choose to continue carrying that weight...
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: …その枷を背負い続けるというのなら…
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: …如果妳还要继续背负那个枷锁的话…
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: …如果妳還要繼續背負那個枷鎖的話…
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: …Si je continue à porter ce fardeau…
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: …Wenn ich diese Last weiterhin tragen würde…
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: …seguirá llevando esa carga…
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: …Continuará carregando esse peso…
Data.UnitTalk_THA: …หากยังคงแบกรับภาระนั้นต่อไป…
Data.UnitTalk_IND: …Jika terus memikul beban itu…
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: …Nếu bạn tiếp tục gánh chịu cái ách đó…

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 내 의뢰를 수행하겠나?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Will you carry out my request?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 私の依頼を受け入れるか？
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 妳要接受我的委托吗？
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 妳要接受我的委託嗎？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Vais-je suivre ma conviction ?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Wirst du meinen Auftrag ausführen?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: ¿Realizarás mi encargo?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Executará meu pedido?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ฉันจะทำตามคำสัญญาของตัวเอง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Akankah aku menjalankan kepercayaanku?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Bạn sẽ thực hiện nhiệm vụ của tôi không?

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>메이드장</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Oh dear <color=#F7BE45>Master Maid</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>メイド長</color>。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>女仆长</color>。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>女僕長</color>。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>Maid-san</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>Oberste Maid</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>Jefa de sirvientas</color>.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 그들에게 설명해도 이해할 수 없을 것 같아서?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Because you believe they would never understand?
